content.title: Penn State wins 2026 DI wrestling championship for fifth straight title
content.text: Penn State captured its fifth-straight DI wrestling title, winning the 2026 championship, beating out runner-up Oklahoma State by over 50 points. The 2026 DI men's wrestling championships were held at Rocket Arena in Cleveland, Ohio, on Thursday, March 19, through Saturday, March 21. The NCAA Division I Wrestling Committee met in person to select the remaining 42 at-large qualifiers, which were announced on March 10, while brackets and seeding were announced on NCAA.com on March 11. 👉 Click here to view the final team scores Below you can find the complete schedule of the 2026 DI men's wrestling championship. 2026 NCAA DI men's wrestling championship brackets ➡️ Click here for the complete championship weight-by-weight brackets 2026 NCAA DI men's wrestling championship schedule *All times Eastern Tuesday, March 10 Automatic qualifiers Wednesday, March 11 Selection show Brackets released Thursday, March 19 | Results Preliminaries Preliminaries and wrestle-backs Friday, March 20 | Results Quarterfinals and wrestle-backs Semifinals and wrestle-backs Saturday, March 21 | Results Consolation finals Championship finals NCAA DI men's wrestling championship history Oklahoma State is the winningest program in NCAA DI men's wrestling history with 34 national titles, while 467 athletes have earned All-American honors. Of those 467 All-Americans, 142 of them won NCAA titles.
